decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core offer and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations, and the expanding firm has slack to keep developing it.
Apron connectivity underpins the integrated digital apron strategy, and with no evident shortfall the firm keeps it while results mature.
Billing software sits further from the core and is only mentioned on the site, but slack from growth lets the firm carry it while its contribution to integrated offers is still uncertain.
Resource management is close to the established offer and complements turnaround management, so it likely meets aspirations.
The safety alert service builds on tower and surveillance expertise and serves safety goals central to customers, so absent a shortfall it is retained.
